contact.basis: First-floor entry/loggia approach identified in original HABS sheet4 and cleared Qualla entrance photograph; replaces the earlier roof-side point[4,-8.2]. The source bare-earth elevation is independent; verification pending.

verticalDatum: NAVD88 meters; USGS 3DEP PA_WesternPA_2019_D20 bare-earth DEM
attribution: USGS 3D Elevation Program, PA_WesternPA_2019_D20; public domain
method: Exact native-pixel window, not a warped/fitted export. NAD83 GRS80 UTM17 projection and bilinear cell-center sampling. One-meter signed local review grid; no flattening, fitting, clipping or source-elevation changes.
limitations: 2019 bare-earth lidar product; elevations under buildings are provider-interpolated, not a measured interior floor.
Generalized map registration, local 111320 meters/degree approximation and uncorrected WGS84/NAD83 epoch differences limit accuracy.
Building floors and rock/water geometry remain separate photographic interpretations. Compatible host terrain is required.
